description: Rothco’s Wintuck Watch Cap is engineered to keep you warm and comfortable in extreme cold conditions. Made from a non-allergenic fiber, this winter hat offers unmatched insulation without causing irritation, making it ideal for sensitive skin. The cap’s double-layered material adds extra warmth, ensuring you’re fully protected from harsh winter elements. Designed for both comfort and durability, the Wintuck Watch Cap provides a snug, secure fit that covers your head and ears, making it an excellent choice for outdoor activities in cold weather. Made in the USA, this cap combines high-quality craftsmanship with functional design, delivering reliable cold-weather protection while remaining lightweight and comfortable. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
